description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class named CategoryController responsible for handling administrative category management functions in a web e-commerce application. It includes methods for creating, editing, saving, deleting, moving, and listing categories, primarily via HTTP requests and responses, with some AJAX handling.

classes.name: CategoryController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling category administration functions including CRUD operations, hierarchy management, and AJAX requests.

methods.name: displayCategoryEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request for editing a category by ID and delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategoryCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request for creating a new category and delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Prepares and displays the category form for editing or creation, populating model attributes accordingly.

methods.name: saveCategory
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a category, performing validation and parent-child relationship handling.

methods.name: displayCategories
methods.description: Displays the list of categories; actual data loading likely via AJAX.

methods.name: pageCategories
methods.description: Processes AJAX POST request for paginated category data, filtering by name if provided, returning JSON.

methods.name: displayCategoryHierarchy
methods.description: Displays the hierarchical view of categories.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a category by ID.

methods.name: moveCategory
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to move (reparent) a category.

methods.name: checkCategoryCode
methods.description: Validates if a category code is already in use.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu-related model attributes for the views.
